_readme: Room types used by the procedural prison generator (scripts/systems/prison_generator.gd). 'affinity' nudges which stat tends to matter there, 'danger' scales heat/damage, 'color' drives the map node art. Add a room by copying a block; add matching events in events.json with the same room id.

rooms.name: Cell Block
rooms.blurb: Four hundred men pretending to be asleep.

rooms.name: Cafeteria
rooms.blurb: Loud, crowded, and legally not food.

rooms.name: The Yard
rooms.blurb: Open sky, open sightlines, open hostility.

rooms.name: Laundry
rooms.blurb: Steam, noise, and an excellent number of places to not be.

rooms.name: Workshop
rooms.blurb: Tools they should not have left out. They left them out.

rooms.name: Medical Wing
rooms.blurb: Where injuries go to become slightly different injuries.

rooms.name: Guard Station
rooms.blurb: Coffee, keys, and eleven people paid to look at you.

rooms.name: Security Hub
rooms.blurb: Every camera in the building, and one very bored operator.

rooms.name: Maintenance
rooms.blurb: Pipes, panels, and a ceiling that is more suggestion than structure.

rooms.name: The Sewer
rooms.blurb: It smells like a decision you are about to regret.

rooms.name: Prison Library
rooms.blurb: Nine hundred legal thrillers and one very specific blueprint.

rooms.name: Chapel
rooms.blurb: Quiet, unguarded, and full of people making promises.

rooms.name: Outer Wall
rooms.blurb: Forty feet of concrete and the last bad idea you will have here.

heat_bands.name: RELAXED
heat_bands.flavor: The guards are discussing a television programme.

heat_bands.name: HEIGHTENED
heat_bands.flavor: Extra patrols. The good torches are out.

heat_bands.name: HIGH ALERT
heat_bands.flavor: Dogs. There were never dogs before.

heat_bands.name: LOCKDOWN
heat_bands.flavor: Every door in the building just agreed on something.
